findings.description:
Log (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#62-86) contract sets array length with a user-controlled value:
	- History.push(LastMsg) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#83)

Reentrancy in WALLET.Collect(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#21-35):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.call.value(_am)() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#29)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- acc.balance -= _am (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#31)
	WALLET.Acc (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#50) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- WALLET.Acc (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#50)
	- WALLET.Collect(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#21-35)
	- WALLET.Put(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#11-19)

WALLET.Collect(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#21-35) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- acc.balance >= MinSum && acc.balance >= _am && now > acc.unlockTime (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#26)

WALLET.Put(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#11-19) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- _unlockTime > now (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_034.sol#17)
